text:
nora: thought from today's config review: what if we had a 'staged-validate' apply mode that runs the new runtime config only on health-check traffic and synthetic probes before exposing to real customers? keeps quotas intact and validates routing paths.

dev-bot: ci-check: make sure synthetic probes are marked so they don't affect rate-limits.

sam: good idea. implementation details: we need a probe header X-Synthetic-Probe and a probe routing namespace. Also new apply states: VALIDATING -> VALIDATION_FAILED -> READY.

ria: UX: Console should show probe results (success rate, p95, response bodies sample) and let operator 'promote' to echo-run or full rollout. Show a green/red badge.

ops-bot: note: ensure we retain correlation id for probes and include in auditline. Also limit concurrent staged-validates per org to 2.

nora: API sketch: POST /runtime/configs.apply {"config_id":"route_v4","mode":"staged-validate","probe_pct":0.01,"ttl_secs":300} will return probe_snapshot_id.

sam: will add lint and proto for mode values. owners: runtime-api (sam), console (ria), telemetry (nora).

ria: will mock the card with probe table + promote button.

nora: filing RFC after sync.
